column2: [intro]
In my life, everything’s a mess,
I lose my way, can’t seem to guess.
Choices make me panic and sway,
Sometimes I have nothing to say.
I’m in ambiguity, indecision’s game,
In this artistic blur, without a name.
But deep down, it makes me smile,
Not having an opinion, it’s worthwhile.
I hear folks talk, they seem so sure,
Of their views and future allure.
I just go with the flow and the breeze,
Sometimes I have no opinion, it’s my ease.
I’m in ambiguity, indecision’s game,
In this artistic blur, without a name.
But deep down, it makes me smile,
Not having an opinion, it’s worthwhile.
[ solo ]
Sometimes I have no opinion, it’s my choice,
I live my life without a single voice.
In this crazy world, I’m an alien sight,
I’m the quirky singer, Mr. Fantasy in the light.
[outro]
